These megathrust # earthquake and # tsunami warnings make me shut down. I know I have to pack an emergency bag and all. But… you know… I live alone. I don't have an emergency contact lmao, and there's this sense of "what's the point?" ykwim? I live in the northern part of Jakarta, near the beach, like seriously right next to it. And North Jakarta is one of the regions with a higher potential to get hit by a tsunami and feel the tremor quite strongly. I live in an apartment complex on the 16th floor. Our warning system is literally just that one app from BMKG, Indonesia's Agency for Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics. It will go off by the time it hits us. That's what usually happens. I remember when I was in Jogja last year, I felt the tremor from the earthquake whose epicenter was in the southern sea before the app went off telling me about the earthquake lmaooo. How likely am I to survive the megathrust?
